rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for saying preferably or if possible.

example.english: Ideally, you should leave early to avoid traffic.
example.traditional: 你最好早啲出門口，避開塞車。
example.jyutping: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 zou2 di1 ceot1 mun4 hau2 bei6 hoi1 sak1 ce1

rows.jyutping: lei5 soeng2 ge3 cing4 fong3 haa6
rows.note: Use this when the preference depends on having ideal circumstances rather than simply stating what is preferable.

example.english: Ideally, the project can be completed by the end of the month.
example.traditional: 理想嘅情況下，工程可以喺月底前完成。
example.jyutping: lei5 soeng2 ge3 cing4 fong3 haa6 gung1 cing4 ho2 ji5 hai2 jyut6 dai2 cin4 jyun4 sing4

rows.note: Use this when ideally means doing something perfectly or without flaws.

example.english: They handled the whole thing ideally, without a single mistake.
example.traditional: 佢哋完美咁搞掂晒成件事，一個錯處都冇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jyun4 mei5 gam3 gaau2 dim6 saai3 seng4 gin6 si6 jat1 go3 co3 cyu3 dou1 mou5
